Company History & Mission

About Harcon Precision Metals

Four decades of precision metal craftsmanship, cutting-edge machine engineering, and client-dedicated manufacturing solutions.

Legacy of Precision

Decades of Manufacturing Excellence

Founded in 1979, Harcon Precision Metals was established with a singular objective: to deliver the highest precision sheet metal fabrication and CNC machining services with unmatched accountability and craftsmanship.

Over more than 40 years, our team has grown alongside our clients in high-stakes industries—including commercial avionics, medical diagnostics, telecommunications, and defense. We invest continuously in high-speed fiber laser cutting systems, multi-axis automated CNC machining centers, and comprehensive shop floor scheduling software.

Today, our unified 60,000 square foot facility in San Diego brings together engineering consultation, prototyping, high-volume production, robotic welding, chemical finishing, and turn-key mechanical assembly under one rigorous quality control system.

Engineered Advantage

Technology & Quality Assurance

CAD / CAM / ERP

Driven by Advanced Software

At Harcon, high precision starts long before metal is shaped. Our engineering team utilizes SolidWorks 3D Modeling and specialized sheet metal unfolding algorithms directly integrated with our CNC machine controls.

Direct import of STEP, IGES, DXF, and SolidWorks CAD files
Real-time CNC nesting to minimize raw material waste and lower part cost
Automated toolpath generation reducing programming lead times
Software Integration Suite
  • MIETrak Pro ERP: Real-time production visibility, job routing, inventory control, and traceable lot numbers.
  • SolidWorks 3D: Complete Design for Manufacturability (DFM) reviews to prevent costly tooling rework.
  • CAMWorks & Amada AP100: Direct multi-axis CNC machine programming and automated nesting.
Quality Control Standards
  • Calibrated CMM Inspection: First Article Inspections (FAI) and automated dimensional verification down to ±0.0001".
  • Material Traceability: Mill test reports, certificates of conformance, and compliance documentation.
  • Lean Manufacturing: Continuous improvement pipelines eliminating waste across sheet metal cutting and machining.
Cost Optimization

Efficiency & Cost Control

We understand that manufacturing success depends on balancing uncompromising precision with commercial feasibility. Through automated barcode labor tracking and material optimization in MIETrak Pro, we deliver transparent, competitive pricing on every production run.

Elimination of duplicate tooling through comprehensive in-house tooling libraries
Rapid quote turnarounds backed by historical ERP production benchmarks
Just-In-Time (JIT) Kanban scheduling support for high-volume enterprise orders
